KNIFEHERO-MENDED_BODY.title: Your Body
KNIFEHERO-MENDED_BODY.description: Counts what you are made of. Grief is the number of your parts that are not whole; you lose that much HP at the start of each turn. Wholeness is the number that are. If no part of you is broken, your body takes another one.
KNIFEHERO-EVERYTHING_I_MAKE_IS_QUEER.des: The first Attack you create each turn becomes Queer. Whenever a Strike or Defend you own is Exhausted, return it to your draw pile, Queer.
KNIFEHERO-EVERYTHING_I_MAKE_IS_QUEER.fla: You didn't have to be thrown away to come out other.
